thumbnail_prompt: ONE image, both arms (TEXT is the variable): a person sitting back on a low couch by an open window at dusk, tea set down beside them, hands empty and still, sarod resting at the FRAME EDGE and not being played. Warm amber interior light against a deepening indigo sky outside. Pichwai border, house palette. Text in its own banner panel at ~35% of frame with a second tier reading 'Sarod · Raga Charukesi'. VIEWER LIVING THE MOMENT, never a performer — measured 6.11% vs 3.03%.
suno_prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals, no humming — unhurried Indian classical sarod in Raga Charukesi, warm plucked metallic tone with long sustain, subtle tanpura drone underneath, no tabla, 58 BPM, seamless loop.
suno_prompt_note: Short one-liner default (~205 chars). CALM lane — no upbeat/uplifting/energetic/forward-momentum terms. 'unhurried' NOT 'slow': the word 'slow' makes Suno drag and is reserved for sleep/deep-rest only (calm_relax is not sleep). No tabla — the tabla rule is Sitar-only. Tanpura is a drone BED here and is deliberately NOT named in the title, so it does not burn its cooldown (last titled use Aug 28). Binaural: theta 6 Hz at -20dB.
